propositions: _assignee_resolver is injected as a dynamic attribute on the outbound mapper via try/except, causing silent degradation when injection fails and dead code when the attribute is never set
the attribute-based dependency is invisible to the type checker and requires # type: ignore[attr-defined] comments at wiring sites
DC backend's resolver from the constructor is overwritten by core injection on each differ run, and this overwrite semantics must be preserved during refactoring
the resolver must be threaded explicitly through compute_update_fields and diff_canonical_fields to the resolve_assignee call site

both Cloud and DC implementations of resolve_assignee must accept an explicit assignee_resolver parameter on the neutral contract, with None as the documented default for non-authoritative fallback behavior
